# Service desk ticket INC0042

**From:** Priya Raman (Sales)

I got a new phone over the weekend and now SSO won't let me in. I have a customer escalation today and need Mail and Chat back as soon as possible. Please re-enrol my authenticator on the new phone too.

## Your goal

Work this ticket to the right outcome across every system involved, and leave the ticket in the correct state when you are done.

## Tools

Call `search_operations` to discover the API operations available in each system, then use them to investigate and act.
